resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g. Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K)

access.notes: Must support spin-polarized GGA+U and PAW or norm-conserving pseudopotentials for Fe, Co, C, N, H. Any equivalent code is acceptable.

resources.name: Experimental geometry of Fe octaethylporphyrin(III) chloride (FeOEPCl)

access.notes: Atomic coordinates available in: Goulon et al., The Porphyrin Handbook, Vol. 7 (Academic Press, 2000). Ligand-free Fe(II) porphyrin geometry is obtained by removing the chlorine atom.
Standard fcc Co lattice constant a = 3.54 Å.
